skills.name: covercount-event-operations
skills.description: Create CoverCount event briefings with session totals, recorded check-ins and authorized financial results; find sessions or prepare approved visibility/capacity changes. Use for event performance and scheduled event reports, not dining reservations or ticket purchases.
headings: Prepare an explicitly requested management change
skills.description_zh: 生成CoverCount活动简报，汇总场次、已记录签到和获授权的财务结果，查找场次或准备获准的可见性与容量调整；不用于餐饮预订或购票。

skills.name: covercount-guest-messages
skills.description: Draft or send an operational email or SMS to the guest of one CoverCount reservation, inspect messaging eligibility, or check a requested message's status. Use for individual guest communication, not bulk marketing or reservation changes.
headings: Review the text and send once
skills.description_zh: 为单笔CoverCount预订的客人起草或发送业务邮件和短信，检查消息资格或状态；不用于批量营销或变更预订。

skills.name: covercount-manage-reservations
skills.description: Find CoverCount reservations, celebration and guest tags, and table assignments; check availability; or create, cancel, reschedule, resize, or move a booking at the user's request. Use for individual bookings; aggregate briefings and event tickets are separate.
headings: Find the exact booking or availability
skills.description_zh: 查询CoverCount预订、庆祝与客人标签、桌位及可用性，按用户请求创建、取消、改期、调整人数或换位；汇总简报和活动票务另行处理。

skills.name: covercount-refund-recovery
skills.description: Check or request reviewed recovery of a CoverCount refund already selected when a reservation or event registration was cancelled. Use for a stuck cancellation refund; this does not issue discretionary refunds on active bookings or change refund amounts.
headings: Distinguish the request from money movement
skills.description_zh: 检查或请求复核恢复CoverCount预订或活动取消时已选定的退款，处理卡住的取消退款，不给活动中预订发放自主退款或改变金额。

skills.name: covercount-reservation-briefing
skills.description: Create a CoverCount reservation briefing for today, tonight, tomorrow, or next week, including scheduled reads. Use for totals, covers, largest parties, celebration tags such as Birthday or Anniversary, and guest tags such as VIP; event ticket reporting is separate.
skills.description_zh: 生成CoverCount今天、今晚、明天或下周预订简报，汇总预订数、就餐人数、大团体、生日周年与VIP标签，支持计划查询；活动票务报告独立处理。
